name: Agnostic
overview: Scripture reveals that denying the existence of God is folly, as seen in Psalms 14:1 where the fool declares there is no God and is described as corrupt. Salvation and truth are found exclusively in Jesus Christ, who is the only way to the Father (John 14:6; Acts 4:12). Faith comes through hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17), and believers are called to be transformed in mind to discern God's will (Romans 12:2). Jesus also blesses those who believe without seeing Him (John 20:29), emphasizing that faith is essential even when certainty is not visible.
